title: Pegcetacoplan versus Eculizumab in Paroxysmal Nocturnal Hemoglobinuria

extraction_issues.quote: The authors' affiliations are listed in the Paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria (PNH) is a rare, acquired disease characterAppendix.
extraction_issues.reason: 该句显然因版面或抽取生成了错误拼接：应将‘in the Appendix’后的句点与‘Paroxysmal...’断开，且‘characterAppendix’疑似‘characterized by ... Appendix’的混合。原文应为‘... in the Appendix. Paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria (PNH) is a rare, acquired disease characterized by ...’

self_check: 已核对关键数据：主要终点调整均差3.84 (95%CI 2.33-5.34, P<0.001)；敏感性分析2.69 (1.99-3.38)；免输血率85% vs 15%；网织红细胞变化-136±7 vs +28±12；LDH变化-15±43 vs -10±71；FACIT-F差异11.9 (5.49-18.25)；血红蛋白正常化34% vs 0%等。确认与摘要和正文一致。未发现其他文本提取疑点；注意摘要中‘characterAppendix’疑点已在issues中标记。
